title: Club founded
text: A group of local players turn one ground and a bold idea into Titan Cricket Club.

title: First major trophy
text: The Titans lift their first National T20 Cup after a final decided in the last over.

title: Top division debut
text: Titan step onto the national stage and finish their first season in the top four.

title: Record winning streak
text: Seven straight wins set a club record that still stands today.

title: The current era
text: A young, fearless squad enters the season ranked second and chasing the next chapter.
